## 404. The grammar's witnesses derived from its laws (GS6)

PF (study §402) stated the general form of 07 §4.6's step 3 in `Becoming.GrammarPath`: where every step under a class from inside a decided region to outside lands in a set, a line under that class from inside to outside holds a member of the set alike to its start (`«所经必同»`), so where the class holds none of them alike to the start, nothing outside is reached (`«所经不同则不及»`). GS4's witness under "a member or not" (§394) is a case of it, proved there by its own induction. Board rule 9 has the special law derived from the general one, the general module imported by the special one, and the direct proof gone. PF wrote that change as a proposal to the owner of `Becoming.GrammarCases` (its kit, `PROPOSED-GrammarCases-corollary.diff`) and landed `GrammarPath` as a leaf until it was decided; this item takes it. An independent review (three Claude Opus agents, one each on the Lean, the texts and rule 9) found four more direct inductions in the GS line's own modules that re-prove a law of the core, and they are derived too. No new law.

**What was built.** In `Becoming.GrammarCases`: namespace `SharedCondition` gains `firstFamily` (a member of the first family or not, as a `Bool`), `first_left_into_condition` (along `affecting`, a step from the first family to outside it ends at a stage of the condition) and `first_never_left` (along `fed`, no step leaves the first family), and loses `affecting_member_step`, `affecting_member_stays`, `fed_step` and `fed_stays`; `affecting_member_outside`, `fed_outside`, `TwoLines.line_in_family` and `ThirdThing.family_keeps_third` keep their statements with new proofs. The module goes from 42 theorems in 69 declarations to 40 in 68. In `Becoming.GrammarScope`, `LineOfDescent.Endless.member_line` keeps its statement with a new proof; the module stays at 37 theorems in 44 declarations.

**What it says.** Each of these facts is now a case of a law of the core: proved by the law from one-step facts of its net, with no induction of its own, not a second proof of the same fact. In the shared-condition witness, the two negative results take one law: under any class, where every step under it from inside a decided region to outside lands in a set, a line from inside reaches nothing outside unless the class holds a member of that set alike to the line's start. Along affecting the first family is left only into the condition, which "a member or not" holds apart from the first family's first member; along feeding alone it is never left. [AI reading] So the contrast GS4 drew, a condition the members affect against one they only feed from, is the contrast between a region left through a set and one not left at all.
